body.name: Rational table and backpointer certificate
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Cert}(G,K,\Sigma,\mathcal T)\) lists every finite \((t,q,D_t(q),P_t(q))\), the locally charged rational summands for \(H_t\), the accepted root state, and the recovered labels obtained by following backpointers from the root.
